import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    n = int(input_data[0].strip())
    s = input_data[1].strip() if len(input_data) > 1 else ""
    
    countMax = 0
    countNoInside = 0
    currentWordLength = 0
    inBrackets = False
    
    for ch in s:
        if ch == '(':
            countMax = max(countMax, currentWordLength)
            currentWordLength = 0
            inBrackets = True
        elif ch == ')':
            if currentWordLength > 0:
                countNoInside += 1
            currentWordLength = 0
            inBrackets = False
        elif ch == '_':
            if inBrackets:
                if currentWordLength > 0:
                    countNoInside += 1
            else:
                countMax = max(countMax, currentWordLength)
            currentWordLength = 0
        else:
            currentWordLength += 1
    
    countMax = max(countMax, currentWordLength)
    print(f"{countMax} {countNoInside}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
